thread:
tara: Spotted a pre-promote drift in rwd-v4q on the customer-support-longform cohort. A/B at 1% for 1h. Posting quick notes and suggested gate changes.

hassan: What metrics are off?

tara: Snapshot (support-longform, n=1.2k):
```
baseline (v4)        | canary (v4q)
MRR: 0.812            | 0.798 (-1.7%)
answer_fidelity: 94.2%| 90.9% (-3.3pp)
prefix-match: 0.4%    | 3.1% (new)
p95 latency: 480ms    | 360ms (faster)
```

nina: prefix-match jump is worrying (we've seen tokenization boundary issues on quantized configs). Are examples single-turn or multi-turn?

tara: mix, but the prefix failures correlate with long quoted user content and unusual punctuation (bullet lists, em-dashes).

eval-bot: ALERT: slice=customer-support-longform. key_signal=prefix_match. delta=+2.7pp (p=0.005). recommendation: hold promotion; increase shadow to 3k; run tokenization-consistency test and rerun on 500 failing cases with FP16 variant.

hassan: Current rollout rule:
```
rollout:
  init_pct: 1
  promote_after: 2h
  thresholds:
    global_mrr_drop: -1.5%
    cohort_prefix_match: +1.0pp
  autofallback: true
  fallback_window: 1h
```

nina: Two immediate moves: (1) tighten cohort_prefix_match to +0.5pp for longform cohorts, (2) add a pre-promote tokenization check that compares byte-level tokenization differences between v4q and v4 for 500 samples. If >0.5% token mismatch for those samples, block.

ops: can run a tokenization-consistency sweep and spin a 2k shadow on canary nodes. ETA ~20m. Also propose enabling "soft-fallback" routing: route detected prefix-fail requests to fp16 variant while leaving rest on q4.

hassan: Agree with soft-fallback. Also suggest updating autofallback to require sustained delta over 2 windows (2x30m) before rolling back, to avoid noisy spikes.

tara: Plan: pause promote, tighten cohort_prefix_match to +0.5pp, enable tokenization pre-check (500 sample gate), kick tokenization sweep + 2k shadow, add soft-fallback to fp16 for prefix-fail hits. If prefix-match remains >+1.0pp after 2h sustained, trigger automatic rollback. I'll open the PR for the rollout change and add notes to the runbook ("quant-token-boundary-sanity").

nina: I'll prepare the tokenization test harness and the 500-sample pre-promote runner.

eval-bot: NOTE: recommend logging token boundaries and example ids for any prefix-match failures to speed root-cause.

tara: Thanks everyone. Will update once sweep finishes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
